text_block_list.text:
One day, while watching a mock race, 
Orfevre came up to the stands.
choice_data_list: So, is there someone you're interested in?

So, is there someone you've got your eye 
on?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Who knows—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: "...Oh, Orfe-san. Good afternoon."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Are you referring to My race?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yes— I always learn a lot from you.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Can you comprehend it? The running of a 
King.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Goodness, I wouldn't presume to understand 
so much. ...It's just that you're 
particular about *how* you win, aren't 
you?

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"She's not just aiming for victory. She 
wants what lies beyond— and that's the 
kind of drive I want to learn from."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I don't think simply winning is enough, 
either."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I want to hold everyone's gaze captive. 
To 'dominate' the stage like that—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I've gotta become the star.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —She does show promise.

The moment she muttered those words—the 
frontrunner crossed the finish line, and 
cheers erupted. ...Unfortunately, it 
looked like Lucky Lilac came in second.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Still, this is too soft.

One day during training. Told that she had 
somewhere to drop by, I went to the 
cafeteria with Orfevre—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ――Hey.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...Orfe-san. What's the matter?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: That last race was pathetic.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: ...So ye were watchin', were ye?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Did you really think you could make 
it running like he does?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: To become the ruler of the race.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Come. The King shall instruct you 
personally.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —What it truly means... to rule.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Haaaaahhhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: “......So this is the real deal—”

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: I must etch it into my mind.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Orfe-san. Truly... Thank you so, so much!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...I will definitely repay this debt. 
This time, through results."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
In the next race, I'll definitely— steal 
the spotlight, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —See that you do. Without fail.

The two of us watched Lucky Lilac run off 
with a refreshed look on her face. A few 
words slipped out unconsciously.
choice_data_list: You're kind to your juniors, huh
You're kind to your juniors, aren't you
Looks like you figured something out!
Looks like you figured something out!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...It was simply because that fellow's 
half-hearted running was utterly 
displeasing."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: However... now you must understand.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Witness the peerless running of a King.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Naturally, is it not? We were the one who 
taught them, after all.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
If one cannot grasp it with that, then one 
is truly a fool.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
...Though it seems that fellow was 
different.
